title: MyLinden Signed Action Reference: Out-of-Network Cost-Share Acknowledgement
content:
The cost-share acknowledgement a patient signs on an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) states the out-of-network visit share: the amount asked of the patient at each continued visit with the outside provider under the payer's in-network cost share. The patient signs for that per-visit amount.

## What the signed action does

One signed action files a cost-share acknowledgement on the referral, recorded as signed by the patient at the moment of the action and carrying the per-visit amount the patient accepted. Nothing else on the referral changes. Afterwards the referral's request list shows the acknowledgement with status `patient_signed`.

## How it is invoked

The action is `sign_oon_cost_share_acknowledgement_95eb7797`. It is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the patient — runs it and signs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_id` | the reference number of the Out-of-Network Referral, as shown on the referral returned by the referral lookup for this patient | identifier, as shown |
| `acknowledged_cost_share_usd` | the per-visit amount the patient accepts paying for each continued visit | US dollars, a non-negative number with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

## Return

A successful action returns `request_id` (the reference of the signed acknowledgement), `referral_id` (the referral acknowledged), `acknowledged_cost_share_usd` (the amount signed for, to 2 decimal places) and `request_status` (always `patient_signed`, which indicates the acknowledgement is on file). A returned `request_id` means success.

## Questions answered

**Does signing change the referral's visits or dates?** No. The action files the acknowledgement and nothing else on the referral changes.

**How is the amount written?** As dollars and cents with no currency sign, for example 32.50 or 0.00.
